[[File:DeathStarCannon.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Death Star cannon]]
This '''cannon''' was a heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] located near the [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

==History==
During the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] battle plan required [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to [[Trench Run Defense|navigate]] a trench along the surface in order to reach the thermal exhaust port&mdash;a direct hit from a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] would trigger a chain reaction to destroy the station. However, before the assault on the trench could begin, the Rebels needed to eliminate the cannon on the surface. Since the cannon was too heavily armored to attack directly, [[Rookie One]] and [[Ru Murleen]] of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] opened a gap in its [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] and flew into the superstructure. There they destroyed several power relays, disabling the weapon and clearing the way for the Alliance forces to begin their trench runs.
